title: Publication-grade benchmark artefact with hardware and seed pinned
description:
Assemble the publication-grade benchmark artefact under `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/` consolidating all S1-S5 outputs with hardware fingerprint, seed pins, and the figures from T27.

## Background

Epic success criterion 9: a reproducible benchmark artefact lives at `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/`, with criterion JSONs, hardware fingerprint, seed pins, and `scripts/permanent-repro.sh` runs end-to-end. This issue is the artefact assembly step — it consumes S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 outputs (already individually committed) and produces a top-level `README.md` that pins the dataset.

The artefact directory layout:
- `README.md` — overview, hardware fingerprint, seed pins, figure index.
- `criterion/` — copies of relevant criterion JSON outputs.
- `figures/` — output of T27.
- `csvs/` — S1/S2/S3/S4/S5 CSVs.
- `provenance.json` — exact commit SHA, rustc version, OS, ROCm version, hardware identifiers.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/README.md` exists, listing every CSV, figure, and criterion JSON included.
- [ ] [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/provenance.json` records commit SHA, `rustc --version`, `lscpu`, `rocminfo` (when available), and the seeds used.
- [ ] [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/figures/` is populated by T27's plot scripts.
- [ ] [hard] `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/csvs/` contains the S1-S5 CSVs with conventional names.
- [ ] [hard] User has signed off on the artefact (recorded as an `## Approval` section in the artefact README).
